mapper.select: select exists(select 1 from t_usr_interest where int_user_id = #{userId} and int_target_type = 1 and int_target_id = #{positionId} and int_status = 1)
select p.pos_id from t_pos p join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = p.pos_company_id and c.cmp_status = 1 where p.pos_id = #{positionId} and p.pos_status = 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into t_usr_interest (int_user_id, int_target_type, int_target_id, int_status, int_created_at, int_updated_at) values (#{userId}, 1, #{positionId}, 1, now(), now()) on duplicate key update int_updated_at = if(int_status = 1, int_updated_at, now()), int_status = 1
mapper.update: update t_usr_interest set int_status = 0, int_updated_at = now() where int_user_id = #{userId} and int_target_type = 1 and int_target_id = #{positionId} and int_status = 1
mapper.select: select p.pos_id as position_id, p.pos_title as title, c.cmp_id as company_id, c.cmp_name as company, c.cmp_logo_url as company_logo, c.cmp_verify_status as company_verified, p.pos_work_city as city, p.pos_salary_min as salary_min, p.pos_salary_max as salary_max, p.pos_experience_required as experience, p.pos_education_required as education, p.pos_job_type as job_type, json_unquote(json_extract(p.pos_jd_json, '$.description')) as description, (select group_concat(distinct ps.psk_name order by ps.psk_required desc separator ',') from t_pos_skill ps where ps.psk_position_id = p.pos_id) as tags_csv, exists(select 1 from t_app_record ar join t_tal t on t.tal_id = ar.app_candidate_id where t.tal_user_id = #{userId} and ar.app_position_id = p.pos_id) as applied, (p.pos_status = 1 and c.cmp_status = 1) as available from t_usr_interest i join t_pos p on p.pos_id = i.int_target_id join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = p.pos_company_id where i.int_user_id = #{userId} and i.int_target_type = 1 and i.int_status = 1 order by i.int_updated_at desc, i.int_id desc
